description: Publication selection and public-purpose metadata for /tracker/. This file selects canonical records; it is not an independent truth store.

programs.name: Feeding Our Future / federal child nutrition
programs.purpose: Federal child-nutrition programs reimburse participating organizations for eligible meals and snacks. Feeding Our Future operated as a sponsor in Minnesota.

programs.name: Housing Stabilization Services
programs.purpose: A Minnesota Medicaid benefit designed to help eligible people with disabilities and seniors find and maintain housing; the program ended October 31, 2025.

programs.name: EIDBI / autism services
programs.purpose: Early Intensive Developmental and Behavioral Intervention is a Minnesota Medicaid benefit for medically necessary services for eligible people under 21 with autism spectrum disorder or related conditions.

programs.name: Minnesota Medicaid program integrity / high-risk services
programs.purpose: Minnesota DHS uses program-integrity controls to screen providers, review claims, investigate suspected fraud and recover inappropriate payments across Medicaid services, including services designated high-risk.
